articles.summary: ST Bancorp, Inc. (ST) (NASDAQ: STBA), the holding company for ST Bank, announced net income of $38.6 million for the third quarter of 2026 compared to $36.6 million for the second quarter of 2026 and $35.0 million for the third quarter of 2025. Diluted earnings per share was a record high of $1.09 for the third quarter of 2026, an increase of $0.07, or 6.9%, compared to $1.02 for the second quarter of 2026 and an increase of $0.18, or 19.8%, compared to $0.91 for the third quarter of 2025. Diluted earnings per share growth was due to both higher net income and share repurchases of 8.3% of outstanding shares since September 30, 2025. Third Quarter of 2026 Highlights : Strong return metrics with return on average assets (ROA) of 1.55%, return on average equity (ROE) of 10.84% and return on average tangible shareholders' equity (ROTE) (non-GAAP) of 14.81% compared to ROA of 1.49%, ROE of 10.37% and ROTE (non-GAAP) of 14.15% for the second quarter of 2026. articles.summary: ST Bancorp, Inc. (ST) (NASDAQ: STBA), the holding company for ST Bank, announced today that a conference call detailing the company's third quarter 2026 earnings will be held live via webcast at 1:00 pm ET, Thursday, October 22, 2026. Christopher J. McComish, chief executive officer, David G. Antolik, president and Mark Kochvar, chief financial officer, will conduct the conference call. The public is invited to listen. ST Bancorp, Inc. intends to release its third quarter earnings before the market opens, Thursday, October 22, 2026. PERTINENT USER INFORMATION: What: ST Bancorp, Inc. Third Quarter Earnings Conference Call When: 1:00 pm ET, Thursday, October 22, 2026 Where: ST Bank's Investor Relations webpage ( stbancorp.com ) How: Live and replay webcast over the internet After the live presentation, the webcast will be archived at stbancorp.com for 12 months. To Ask Questions: Prior to the webcast, please email questions to investor.relations@stbank.com

articles.summary: The Board of Directors of ST Bancorp, Inc. (ST) (NASDAQ: STBA), the holding company for ST Bank, approved a $0.38 per share cash dividend on October 28, 2026. This is an increase of $0.01, or 2.70 percent, compared to a cash dividend of $0.37 per share declared in the prior quarter and an increase of $0.02, or 5.56 percent, compared to a cash dividend of $0.36 per share declared in the same period in the prior year. The annualized yield using the October 27, 2026 closing price of $50.59 is 3.00 percent. The dividend is payable November 27, 2026 to shareholders of record on November 12, 2026. About ST Bancorp, Inc. and ST Bank ST Bancorp, Inc. is a $9.9 billion bank holding company that is headquartered in Indiana, Pennsylvania and trades on the NASDAQ Global Select Market under the symbol STBA. Its principal subsidiary, ST Bank, was established in 1902 and operates in Pennsylvania and Ohio. For more information visit stbancorp.com or stbank.com
